placements.role: Official sports data and live-odds supplier to Kalshi under a June 2026 global prediction-market partnership covering MLB, NHL, MLS and UFC, plus integrity monitoring.

evidence.claim: Sportradar will provide Kalshi official sports data and live odds to power pre-game and in-play markets plus an integrity framework including Sportradar UFDS AI and the Sportradar Integrity Exchange.
evidence.source_name: Sportradar, Sportradar and Kalshi Announce First-of-its-Kind Data and Infrastructure Global Partnership for Prediction Markets
evidence.source_excerpt: Official Sports Data and Live Odds: Fast, reliable, accurate official data and live odds to power pre-game and in-play markets, enhancing market efficiency while ensuring timely settlements

placements.role: B2B sports-data and streaming-rights holder: a substantial portion of Genius offerings use sports properties acquired under rights granted by sports organizations, including sports data and streaming rights.

evidence.claim: A substantial portion of Genius Sports Limited offerings and services use sports properties acquired under rights granted by sports organizations including sports data and streaming rights.
evidence.source_name: Genius Sports Limited Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
evidence.source_excerpt: A substantial portion of our offerings and services use sports properties acquired under rights granted by sports organizations including (inter alia) sports data and streaming rights.

placements.role: Vendor of cloud and on-premises market-surveillance software used by banks, brokers, more than 50 exchanges and 22 regulators.

evidence.claim: Nasdaq's surveillance solution is designed for banks, brokers and other market participants and also powers surveillance for more than 50 exchanges and 22 regulators.
evidence.source_name: Nasdaq, Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
evidence.source_excerpt: Our surveillance cloud-enabled and on-premises solution is designed for banks, brokers and other market participants to assist in complying with market rules, regulations and internal market surveillance policies and serves more than 170 clients. We also provide our solution to regulators and exchanges with a robust platform to manage cross-market, cross-asset and multi-venue surveillance. This offering powers surveillance for more than 50 exchanges and 22 regulators.

placements.role: Integrity-services supplier into Kalshi's prediction-market stack (UFDS AI plus Sportradar Integrity Exchange).

evidence.claim: The Kalshi agreement includes Sportradar UFDS AI, which detects suspicious behavior, and Sportradar Integrity Exchange (SIE).
evidence.source_name: Sportradar, Sportradar and Kalshi Announce First-of-its-Kind Data and Infrastructure Global Partnership for Prediction Markets
evidence.source_excerpt: Industry-Leading Integrity Services: Robust integrity framework including Sportradar UFDS AI, which detects suspicious behavior, and Sportradar Integrity Exchange (SIE), which enables participants to share integrity threats through a secure network

placements.role: Listed exchange holding company investing up to $2 billion in Polymarket and becoming a global distributor of Polymarket event-driven data.

evidence.claim: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE) announced a strategic investment in Polymarket of up to $2 billion and will become a global distributor of Polymarket’s event-driven data.
evidence.source_name: Intercontinental Exchange, ICE Announces Strategic Investment in Polymarket
evidence.source_excerpt: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE), a leading global provider of technology and data, today announced a strategic investment in Polymarket, the prediction market and information platform tracking event probabilities across markets, politics, sport and culture. Under the terms of the agreement, ICE will invest up to $2 billion in Polymarket

placements.role: Operator planning Mini-SPX prediction-market contracts listed on Cboe Options Exchange and cleared at OCC, using an options wrapper rather than a binary event contract.

evidence.claim: Cboe plans to launch its first Mini-SPX prediction market contract in the second quarter of 2026, listed on Cboe Options Exchange and centrally cleared by OCC.
evidence.source_name: Cboe Global Markets, Cboe Introduces Innovative Prediction Markets Framework
evidence.source_excerpt: Cboe plans to launch its first Mini-SPX prediction market contract in the second quarter of 2026. The product will use a traditional options wrapper to deliver fixed-return outcome and settle in cash, similar to standard index options. This securities-based product will be listed on Cboe Options Exchange and centrally cleared by OCC.

placements.role: Operator of DraftKings Predictions, launched 19 December 2025 as a CFTC introducing broker, after acquiring Railbird Exchange, a CFTC-registered designated contract market.

evidence.claim: DraftKings Predictions launched on December 19, 2025 under CFTC oversight; on October 21, 2025 DraftKings acquired Railbird Exchange, LLC, a registered designated contract market licensed by the CFTC.
evidence.source_name: DraftKings Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
evidence.source_excerpt: Prediction Markets — DraftKings Predictions launched on December 19, 2025, formally entering prediction markets under the oversight of the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (“CFTC")

placements.role: Venue whose planned prediction-market contracts are centrally cleared by OCC; Cboe is the listing exchange, not the DCO, but the product is routed into OCC clearing.

evidence.claim: Cboe's Mini-SPX prediction market contract will be centrally cleared by OCC.
evidence.source_name: Cboe Global Markets, Cboe Introduces Innovative Prediction Markets Framework
evidence.source_excerpt: This securities-based product will be listed on Cboe Options Exchange and centrally cleared by OCC.

placements.role: Operator of multiple clearing houses (ICE Clear Europe, ICE Clear U.S., ICE Clear Credit and others) that act as CCP for listed derivatives, the clearing pattern Cboe's OCC-cleared wrapper sits alongside.

evidence.claim: ICE operates six clearing houses, each of which acts as a central counterparty that becomes the buyer to every seller and the seller to every buyer.
evidence.source_name: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
evidence.source_excerpt: We operate six clearing houses, each of which acts as a central counterparty, or CCP, that, for its clearing members, becomes the buyer to every seller and the seller to every buyer.

placements.role: Consumer front-end: Sportsbook, iGaming, DFS and DraftKings Predictions distributed through Apple App Store, Google Play and the web.

evidence.claim: DraftKings distributes online sportsbook, iGaming, DFS, digital lottery courier and prediction markets product offerings through websites, direct app downloads, the Apple App Store and the Google Play Store.
evidence.source_name: DraftKings Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
evidence.source_excerpt: We distribute our online sportsbook, iGaming, DFS, digital lottery courier and prediction markets product offerings through various channels, including traditional websites, direct app downloads and global direct-to-consumer digital platforms such as the Apple App Store and the Google Play Store.

placements.role: Online sportsbook operator live in 27 of 33 US jurisdictions that have legalized online sports betting as of 10 February 2026.

evidence.claim: As of February 10, 2026 DraftKings operates its online sports betting product via the DraftKings Sportsbook app in 27 US jurisdictions.
evidence.source_name: DraftKings Inc. Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
evidence.source_excerpt: As of February 10, 2026, 39 U.S. states, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico have some form of authorized sports betting. Of those 41 jurisdictions, 33 have legalized online sports betting. All 33 jurisdictions are live, and DraftKings operates in 27 of them.
